instructions_to_main_agent.core_directive: Transform the Imaldri landing page (Home.jsx) into a mind-blowing, single-screen zero-scroll hero canvas experience centered around the animated couple walking silhouette, dual rotating orbital light-rings, pulsing dot-grid background, and 4 floating thought-clouds with speech-bubble tail indicators, connecting laser beam traces, glowing hover states, and smooth click preview dialogs.
layout_rules: Strictly preserve zero-scroll 100dvh layout constraint across both desktop viewports and mobile 390x844px.
Use flex flex-col h-[calc(100dvh-3.5rem)] justify-between overflow-hidden with tight dynamic scaling (vmin/vh units).
Center hero section: silhouette height scaled dynamically (h-[32vh] sm:h-[42vh] lg:h-[50vh]), surrounded by concentric rotating orbit rings and 4 cloud cards positioned radially.
Ensure bottom CTA bar (headline + Get Started button) stays pinned in view without overlapping silhouette or triggering vertical scrollbars.
cloud_design_system: Clouds MUST look like high-craft thought/speech bubbles with organic pill roundedness (rounded-3xl / rounded-[2rem]), subtle 1px border glow, and backdrop-blur glassmorphism.
Include explicit directional bubble tails (via SVG or positioned pseudo/child elements) pointing toward the central couple silhouette.
Cloud 1 (Archetypes): 'Which archetype is this?' with tag 'Archetypes'
Cloud 2 (Practice): 'What should I say next?' with tag 'Practice'
Cloud 3 (Personal): 'Why do I always do this?' with tag 'Personal'
Cloud 4 (Quiz): 'Who's really texting me?' with tag '3-tap quiz'
Hover effect: scale-105 -rotate-1 with ambient glow ring (box-shadow or cyan/lime accent border tint).
orbit_and_background_enhancements: Dual Orbit Rings: Outer dashed ring rotating clockwise (60s), inner solid gradient ring rotating counter-clockwise (45s).
Interactive Cursor Parallax: Subtle MouseMove tilt / translate shift on orbiting rings and clouds for 2.5D depth.
Connecting Beams: SVG SVG-line overlay connecting central couple to each of the 4 thought clouds with animated dash arrays or gradient pulses.
Tactile Grid Background: Subtle radial radial-gradient mask dot grid overlay (bg-[radial-gradient(var(--line)_1px,transparent_1px)] bg-[size:24px_24px]) to eliminate flat background monotony.
accessibility_and_testing: Add strict data-testid attributes to all interactive elements: data-testid='home-hero', data-testid='home-cloud-{tab}', data-testid='home-hero-silhouette', data-testid='home-get-started', data-testid='home-cloud-dialog'.
Provide dark/light contrast validation on all text labels using APCA/WCAG standards.
Ensure focus states and keyboard navigation work seamlessly across clouds and dialogs.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur)
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Component Reuse: Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable
